create_KimiK2ToolParser: create a KimiK2ToolParser instance with a tokenizer to parse tool calls from Kimi K2 model outputs
extract_tool_calls: extract tool calls from a non-streaming Kimi K2 model output string using regex-based parsing
extract_tool_calls_streaming: extract tool call deltas from streaming Kimi K2 model output with incremental argument diffing
adjust_request: adjust a ChatCompletionRequest or ResponsesRequest to disable special token skipping for tool call parsing
test_KimiK2ToolParser: test the KimiK2ToolParser class and its tool call extraction methods
